title: The Latest Crier for May 11, 2026
items:
Doing a World of Good: Log your Tulip Time volunteer hours

If you volunteered during Tulip Time, make sure you log your hours on Central's World of Good website: https://centralcollege.formstack.com/forms/service_hours. It only takes a minute and your hours help to show the economic impact volunteering has. 
Thanks for helping and making a difference!

Central Student Tradition Breakfast of Champions SP26 is TONIGHT (Monday, 5/11), 9:30-10:30PM

Join us TONIGHT for our annual student tradition Breakfast of Champions in the Market from 9:30-10:30PM! Enjoy Breakfast favs–Fresh toppings bar–fresh local donuts–all beverage stations will be open! Celebrate the end of the semester with a late-night study break where staff and faculty serve up delicious food, encouragement, and fun!
